_comment: Run template for synthetic-ahu-maintenance (generated by CAMBER, no real building): one constant-volume air handler's filter and cooling-valve loop, at the trend's own 5-minute resolution and the rules' defaults. filter_fouling reads the median filter differential pressure over the fan-on samples (FLT_DP; warn at 1.0 in. w.c., fault at 1.5); control_hunting counts the cooling valve's direction reversals beyond a 5 % deadband per observed fan-on hour (CLG_VLV; warn at 6, fault at 12). Both judge fan-on samples only (SF_STS): the unit runs 05:00-21:00, and with the fan off the filter transmitter reads about zero and the valve is shut. Measured: AHU__dirty faults on filter_fouling (median 1.72 in. w.c.); AHU__loading passes it (median 0.95, though its filter crosses 1.0 in the second week); AHU__hunting warns on control_hunting (10.79 reversals per fan-on hour; fault is out of reach at 5 minutes, which can show at most 12); AHU__near_miss passes it (5.39); AHU__healthy passes both. At 10 and at 15 minutes control_hunting declines (info). Keep resample at 5min.
